# Contract — Skip-Art Draft Mode
*Generated by spec-writer. Regenerate on scope changes instead of hand-editing.*

## Definition of Done

Pipeline:
- [ ] `ContentDraftSchema` and `checkDraftIntegrity` defined; tested with plain objects, no mocks (AGENTS.md)
- [ ] `checkReferentialIntegrity` reuses `checkStoryDevIntegrity`; its existing tests pass unchanged
- [ ] `IManifestWriter.writeDraft` and `ValidatePackageUseCase.executeDraft` added, tests first
- [ ] `executeDraft` never calls Art, `manifestWriter.write`, or `worldRegistryRepository.save`
- [ ] `--skip-art` works without `OPENROUTER_ART_MODEL`; the default CLI behavior is unchanged
- [ ] `npm run build:schema` produces no diff, so the game contract is untouched
- [ ] Every phase written test-first (CLI phase verified manually), one commit per phase

Evals:
- [ ] `cases.py` omits `:art` for files without `assets`
- [ ] One draft golden added; `evals/README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` mention `--skip-art`

## Acceptance Criteria

| # | Side | Given | When | Then | Covered by |
|---|------|-------|------|------|------------|
| AC1 | Pipeline | the fixture's story + dev with `draft: true` | `ContentDraftSchema` parses it and `checkDraftIntegrity` runs | parsing succeeds and the error list is empty, even though no assets exist | `src/domain/entities/content-draft.entity.test.ts` |
| AC2 | Pipeline | a draft whose dev targets an unknown quest npc | `checkDraftIntegrity` runs | the same error `checkReferentialIntegrity` would report is returned | `src/domain/entities/content-draft.entity.test.ts` |
| AC3 | Pipeline | an object with `assets` and without `draft: true` | `ContentDraftSchema` parses it | parsing fails | `src/domain/entities/content-draft.entity.test.ts` |
| AC4 | Pipeline | a fresh runId | `executeDraft` runs | Story and Dev are each called once and Art is never called; one draft is written; `write` and `registry.save` are never called | `src/application/use-cases/orchestrate-content-generation.use-case.test.ts` |
| AC5 | Pipeline | a Story output that trips the content guardrails | `executeDraft` runs | it throws `ContentGuardrailViolationError` and Dev is never called | `src/application/use-cases/orchestrate-content-generation.use-case.test.ts` |
| AC6 | Pipeline | a runId whose draft run finished | `execute()` runs with the same runId | Dev is called 0 times, Art once, and the manifest is written | `src/application/use-cases/orchestrate-content-generation.use-case.test.ts` |
| AC7 | Pipeline | a runId with a `done` checkpoint | `executeDraft` runs | no agent is called and the draft is written from the saved story + dev | `src/application/use-cases/orchestrate-content-generation.use-case.test.ts` |
| AC8 | Pipeline | `FileManifestWriter` and a temp output root | `writeDraft` runs | the file lands at `<root>/.drafts/<cityId>/draft.json` and nothing is written under `<root>/<cityId>/` | `src/infrastructure/persistence/file-manifest-writer.test.ts` |
| AC9 | Pipeline | `OPENROUTER_ART_MODEL` unset, free Story/Dev models | `npm run generate -- --brief "<new>" --skip-art --yes` | the draft is written, `output/<cityId>/` and `world-registry.json` are untouched, and OpenRouter logs ≤ 4 requests | `manual: plan Phase 4` |
| AC10 | Evals | the AC9 draft added to `goldens.json` | `npm run eval -- <cityId>` | exactly 4 cases run (no `:art`) without exceptions; `mare-funda` still gets 5 | `manual: plan Phase 5` |

## Quality Gates

Pipeline: `npm test`, `npm run typecheck`, and `npm run build:schema` with no diff.
Evals: `npm run eval` (repo root). Generation and judge models must be `:free`.
